Title: [HUMAN] Architecture decision: where evidence lives
Description: Agent drafts the spike, owner decides. The decision-intelligence reframe makes three weaknesses product-critical: whole graph shipped to every client on connect, no permissions model, in-browser search. Recommended default: evidence does NOT live in the graph - the graph holds decision objects plus links (source-system URLs first, evidence store later). Acceptance: written decision in doc/ covering evidence placement, per-client isolation boundary, and minimum auth bar before any client data is referenced.

Title: Spike: ingestion adopt vs build

Criteria: connectors, self-hostability, per-client isolation, license compat, citation support, maintenance burden, maturity (Semantica is young; canonical repo only, ignore clone mirrors). Acceptance: written recommendation in doc/ that explicitly answers (1) can Semantica serve as the evidence layer and (2) does anything in it invalidate the Athens-substrate choice. No code.

Title: Spec the decision object model

Rides the existing :block/property-of + :block/key model with zero schema migration; the append-only log already records each decision's evolution. Include worked internal-representation examples and the datalog for 'why did we decide X' and 'what decisions touch Y'. Acceptance: spec in doc/, examples validated against internal-representation->atomic-ops.
